quotes: - Test: TC-15, TC-36, TC-37, TC-52, TC-57" (tasks.md, T-11)
outcome `human` naming `FR-1`; ledger round unchanged; no fix-check pack written." (tests.md, TC-15)
a CT-13 hit while `current` differs from the judged version → `human` with CT-13's lines;" (contracts.md, CT-12)
findings.fix: move TC-15, TC-36, TC-37 and TC-57's outcome assertions to T-13's `Test:` (or split the composition into T-13 and list TC-15 there), and keep only the `cuts` return-value assertions in T-11.

sources.situation: the worker for T-11 adds `cuts` and runs TC-15. `cuts` returns `["[human] line changed: FR-1"]`, but the composer has no round-check rule until T-13. `nio jury check S spec --record` then gives `rerun`, not `human`, so the test fails. T-13's title includes "a round-check hit hand over", yet T-13's `Test:` (TC-12, TC-14, TC-34, TC-39) omits TC-15. Nothing marks TC-15 as passing only after T-13.

sources.situation: T-23 is `Parallel: yes` in E-7, next to T-22, and only needs T-1. A worker who starts T-23 when T-1 is done gets `AttributeError: module has no attribute manual` in the setup, because `flow.manual` is created in T-22. The test can't go green until T-22 lands, and nothing in T-23 says so.

findings.title: T-2 and T-3 point at a test that doesn't check what they change
quotes: - Test: TC-17" (tasks.md, T-2, and again T-3)
- Assert: exit 0." (tests.md, TC-17, whose action is "`nio check spec <S> --gate`.")
every skill and card holds the flow-state line with `Never pass \`--by human\``." (tests.md, TC-47)
findings.fix: give T-2 a CLI test (for example, `nio flow --help` lists `manual`, `drive` and `pr`, as quickstart's prerequisites say), and give T-3 TC-47's sentence check. State that T-2 stubs the missing functions, or move the subcommand dispatch into the task that creates each function.

sources.situation: a worker for T-2 wires `fs --auto`, `fsub manual|drive|pr` and the dispatch table, then runs TC-17. The spec-gate test passes whether or not the CLI flags exist, so the worker can't tell it is done. Likewise a worker for T-3 adds the sentence to 17 cards and skills, runs TC-17, and it passes while the sentence may be missing from some files. TC-47 is the check that proves it, but it sits under T-16 and not T-3. T-2 also dispatches to `flow.drive`, `flow.manual` and `flow.pr`, which are created in T-6, T-22 and T-27; the task names no stub for them.

sources.situation: the chain is T-6, T-7, T-8, T-9, T-10. A worker for T-6 writes the claim, then runs TC-44, which reads `skills/auto/SKILL.md`. That file doesn't exist yet (its task, T-10, comes after T-6), so the test fails on a missing file. T-8 has the same problem with TC-5's step-4 check.

T-15 creates `src/nio/agents/fixer.md`, and T-16 doesn't depend on it, so the section can ship before the card exists.
